explanation: OEIS A109227 (decimal numbers whose digits are the 0/1 prime-indicator string of 0..p_n with leading zeros dropped: 1, 11, 1101, 110101, …): 'a(2) and a(121) are primes. Are there any more?' The formal a builds exactly that digit string (ofDigits on the reversed list) and reproduces the DATA. The statement ∃ n > 0, n ∉ {2, 121}, a(n) prime is the positive form of the question. Faithful.
